scripts.build: bun run build:go && bun run build:web
scripts.build:go: go build -trimpath -o dist/pixie ./cmd/pixie && go build -trimpath -o dist/pixie-mcp ./cmd/pixie-mcp
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter @pixie/contracts typecheck && bun --filter @pixie/web typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && bun --filter @pixie/pi-host typecheck && bun --filter @pixie/pi-mcp typecheck
